scene_objective: Sera moves before Ben can speak. Ancient containment protocols — the same techniques that sealed her in a wall for a thousand years — adapted to field conditions. Veraine in containment: conscious, intellectually furious, physically outmatched. Ben turns from the contained antagonist to the valley below, where Torin's void is still expanding.
opening_mode: Sera moves before Ben can speak. Ancient containment protocols — the same techniques that held Veraine in stasis for a millennium, adapted to field conditions.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera moves before Ben can speak — activating ancient containment protocols adapted to field conditions
Sera locks Veraine in a Force-containment field using techniques that held her in stasis for a millennium
Ben turns from the contained Veraine to look down the valley where Torin's void continues to expand

turning_point.trigger: Veraine in containment. Ben turns from the antagonist he has defeated to the friend he has not saved.
turning_point.shift: Veraine in containment. Ben turns from the antagonist he has defeated to the friend he has not saved.

closing_beat: Torin. Still descending. His technique has created a zone of perfect unweaving around him, expanding as he approaches the Scar. He's not fighting the resonance — he's ignoring it. He has his own solution. And it's working. Maetha's warning echoes: 'It replaces you.'

emotional_arc.shift: Relief at Veraine's containment -> immediate dread at Torin's continuing descent

anti_patterns: Sera's containment work is discipline, not vengeance
Do not arrive at clinical articulation of the Force mechanics
Maetha's warning should surface as fragment, not quotation
Sera's face registers neither triumph nor pity—the room is a professional one
